fib: ______ is the unity and harmony of cooperation and understanding between any group and the public it serves.
A community relation is the unity and harmony of cooperation and understanding between any group and the public it serves.

Teaching-learning situation is the focus of supervision with the groups and individuals working to improve the total complex.
______ is the process by which one human being can to a degree know what another thinks, feels or believes.
Communication is the process by which one human being can to a degree know what another thinks, feels or believes.

Public education is an area of public concern since the funds and students are gotten from the public, the school then own public proper accountability of its stewardship.

The principal is a central factor in the communication network.

Supervision is a professional, continuous and cooperative exercise that covers all aspects of the life of a school.
